locations.title: Baby Steps
locations.description:
**Quest Steps:**
- Walk to Dad and wait for him to leave.
- Open the playpen's gate and leave the playpen.
- Look at the "You're SPECIAL!" book to select your SPECIAL stats.
- Listen to Dad and follow him into the hallway.

**Next Quest:** [Growing Up Fast](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357072)

locations.title: Growing Up Fast
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Baby Steps](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357071)

**Quest Steps:**
- Talk to [Amata](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357091) and receive the [Grognak the Barbarian](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357090) skill book.
- Talk to Old Lady Palmer and receive a sweetroll.
- Optional:
   - Talk to Stanley and receive a kid's baseball cap
   - Talk to Beatrice and receive a birthday poem
   - Deal with Butch and his need for your sweetroll.
- Head down to the reactor room to meet Jonas and get your own BB gun.
- Shoot the three targets in the side room from the reactor.
- Kill the radroach that comes out after shooting the targets.
- Stand and take a picture with your dad.

**Quest Rewards:**
- BB Gun
- [Grognak the Barbarian](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357090)

**Next Quest:** [Future Imperfect](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357073)

locations.title: Future Imperfect
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Growing Up Fast](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357072)

**Quest Steps:**
- Talk to your dad about being sick and the G.O.A.T. exam.
- Optional:
   - Intervene the situation with Butch and [Amata](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357091) by either:
      - Warn Butch that the Overseer will stop the Tunnel Snakes if they keep messing with Amata
      - Convince Wally Mack that Butch is using him, causing Wally and Paul to leave
      - Fight Butch, Wally, and Paul
- Speak to Mr. Brotch when entering the exam room
   - You may convince Mr. Brotch to let you skip the exam, allowing you to set your three Tag skills immediately and leave the exam area, completing the quest
- Sit down and take the G.O.A.T exam.
- Turn in your results to Mr. Brotch.
   - You may convince Mr. Brotch to allow you to fill out the results yourself, allowing you to set your three Tag skills, bypassing the results from the answers you gave for the G.O.A.T. exam.
- Leave the exam room.

**Next Quest:** [Escape!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357074)

locations.title: Escape!
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Future Imperfect](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357073)

**Quest Steps:**
- Wake up and speak with [Amata](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357091) about your dad leaving the vault.
- Fight your way through the vault.
- Optional:
   - Along the way through the vault, you'll come across Butch, begging for you to save his mother. You can either:
      - Kill the radroaches and save his mother, where he will give you his [Tunnel Snake outfit](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357092) as a reward
      - Convince Butch that he can take on the radroaches himself (you may also give him a weapon you have to help him)
      - Ignore him, causing Butch to follow you and yell out your direction to Officer Kendall
- Head to the interrogation room towards the Overseer's office, where the player will find Amata being interrogated by her dad and Officer Mack.
   - If the player declined the 10mm pistol from Amata when she woke them up, she will free herself and flee, otherwise, kill Officer Mack.
- Speak with the Overseer. In this conversation, you may:
   - Threaten him for the overseer's office key and terminal password, which will cause him to attack of call for help.
   - Threaten Amata, which will cause him to hand over his key and [Overseer's Terminal Password](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378771).
   - Give up your weapons and ammo, which will cause him to attack the player.
   - Kill the Overseer.
   - Talk to him enough for him to no longer speak to you, allowing you to leave.
- Either use the key or lockpick your way into the Overseer's office.
   - If you were unable to get the key from the Overseer, a spare key can be found in a dresser inside of the Overseer's room.
- Head to the terminal on the Overseer's desk and either use the terminal password or hack it.
   - If you were unable to get the password from the Overseer, the password can be found in a locker near the terminal.
- Open the overseer's tunnel and head down the secret passage to the vault entrance.
- Engage the vault door and speak with Amata to say your goodbyes.
- Leave the vault.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 200 XP

**Next Quest:** [Following in His Footsteps](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357075)

locations.title: Following in His Footsteps
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Escape!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357074)

**Note:** You may skip this quest by either:
- Immediately visiting [Three Dog](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357095) without heading to Megaton and speaking with [Colin Moriarty](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357097).
- Retrieve the journals from the [Jefferson Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356909), automatically starting the quest [Scientific Pursuits](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357077)
- Head to [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907) and speak with [Dr. Li](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357094), automatically starting the quest [Scientific Pursuits](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357077)
- Travelling to [Vault 112](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356866), automatically starting the quest [Tranquility Lane](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357078)

**Quest Steps:**
- Head to the nearby town of [Megaton](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356859).
- Head to the [Moriarty's Saloon](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357096) in the upper level of the town.
- Optional:
   - There are multiple ways to get information about your dad:
      - You may speak to the bartender [Gob](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357099), who, after passing a speech check, points you to Moriarty's private terminal, where you can hack into it to gather information.
      - You may kill Gob to loot the password to Moriarty's terminal off of his body.
      - You may speak to Gob about the terminal, and, after passing a speech test, will reveal to you that Nova knows the password, where you may then speak to her and get the password after a speech check.
     - You may speak to Moriarty directly.
   - If you speak to Moriarty directly:
      - You may pay him 100 caps for information about your father. If you decline this offer, he will raise the price to 300 caps.
      - You may obtain a discount on the information if you help him hunt down and kill [Silver](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357098), giving the player the unmarked quest [300 Pieces of Silver](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378251)
- With the information, head to the [GNR Building Plaza](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356850).
- Once there, you will have to help the Brotherhood of Steel defend against the attacking super mutants and, ultimately, a super mutant behemoth.
   - To help with this fight, you may pick up a [Fat Man](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357076) off of the body of a dead Brotherhood of Steel soldier.
- After clearing all of the super mutants out, head inside and talk to [Three Dog](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357095).
   - Here, there are a few choices:
      - You may convince Three Dog that you may help him fight for 'the cause' after rescuing your dad, which will lead Three Dog to tell the player about [Dr. Li](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357094), starting the quest [Scientific Pursuits](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357077)
      - If the player is unable to convince Three Dog, then he will give you the quest [Galaxy News Radio](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357107) instead

_**Note:** If the player receives the information about their father by passing the speech check, you may still do [Galaxy News Radio](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357107), which will instead reward the player with a key to a weapon cache in [Hamilton's Hideaway](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356816)._

**Quest Rewards:**
- XP
- (Optional) Up to 400 Caps
- (Optional) [Fat Man](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357076)

**Next Quest:** [Galaxy News Radio](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357107) / [Scientific Pursuits](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357077)

locations.title: Scientific Pursuits
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Following in His Footsteps](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357075) / [Galaxy News Radio](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357107)

**Note:** You may skip this quest by heading straight to [Smith Casey's Garage](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356866) at any time.

**Quest Steps:**
- Head down south and gain access to [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907).
- Speak to [Dr. Li](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357094) about your fathers whereabouts, which directs you to head to the [Jefferson Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356909).
- Head to the Jefferson Memorial and enter through the gift shop.
- Make your way through the memorial while finding and collecting your father's Project Purity journals.
- With the information from the journals, head next to the [Smith Casey's Garage](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356866).
- Once inside, head to the backroom, flip the switch on the wall, and enter the hole in floor, leading to Vault 112.
- Enter Vault 112, speak to the Robobrain, receive a [Vault 112 Jumpsuit](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357136), and enter the unoccupied tranquility lounger.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 500 XP

**Next Quest:** [Tranquility Lane](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357078)

locations.title: Tranquility Lane
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Scientific Pursuits](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357077)

**Quest Steps:**
- Once sitting down into the tranquility lounger, the player will be brought into a simulation called Tranquility Lane.
- There are two ways to escape Tranquility Lane:
   1. You may follow the child Betty's tasks (each one decreasing the player's karma), which are:
      1. Make the child Timmy cry
      2. Break up the Rockwells' marriage
      3. Kill Mabel Henderson in a creative way
      4. Kill everyone using the Pint-Sized Slasher mask and the Slasher Knife
   2. Activate the fail safe of the simulation
      1. If you speak to Old Lady Dithers, you will find out that Betty is actually the scientist Stanislaus Braun and that there is a fail safe terminal in the abandoned house.
      2. Once in the abandoned house, you will find multiple objects that place different tones when activated. Putting in the correct order will reveal the fail safe terminal.
         - The order of tones to activate can be heard by the notes that Betty whistles while playing in Tranquility Lane. The order of objects is the radio, pitcher, gnome, pitcher, cinder block, gnome, then the bottle.
      3. Once the terminal is activated, you may use the 'Chinese Invasion' protocol, which will send in Chinese commandos into Tranquility Lane, killing all the citizens, both in the simulation and real life.
- After following either line of choices, it will be revealed that the player's dad has been Doc the dog the whole time, and an exit to the simulation will open up in the playground.
- After leaving the simulation, speak to your dad, where he notes he will be headed back to [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907).

**Quest Rewards:**
- 600 XP

**Next Quest:** [The Waters of Life](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357079)

locations.title: The Waters of Life
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Tranquility Lane](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357078)

**Quest Steps:**
- Head back to the [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907) science lab and talk to your Dad and [Dr. Li](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357094).
- Go back to the [Jefferson Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356909) and meet back up with the science team and your dad.
- Head through the memorial to the control room and preform some maintenance tasks to help get the project working again.
- Speak with your dad and head out of the memorial, going to the intake pipes near the entrance.
- Head to the end of the pipe to start draining the pipe blockage.
- Fight the Enclave on the way back to the control room and then watch the showdown between your dad and the Enclave.
- Talk to Dr. Li and follow her down into the Taft Tunnel below the Jefferson Memorial.
- Fight through the tunnel, killing the Enclave soldiers and ghouls you may come across.
   - In one of the rooms, on a table, you may find a [Chinese Army: Special Ops Training Manual](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357160) skill book.
- If Garza is alive, when arriving to the second part of the Taft Tunnel, Garza will not be able to continue moving forward due to their heart disease. Here, you may:
   - Leave Garza behind
   - Drug Garza with three bottles of buffout to keep them moving
   - Give Garza five stimpaks to stabilize them
- Continue pushing through the Taft Tunnel, eventually having to battle ghouls towards the end.
   - In one of the hallways, on a desk, you can find an [Eyebot Helmet](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357161)
- You'll eventually come across a Brotherhood of Steel checkpoint, where you will be able to head back to the surface.
   - Near the checkpoint, on a picnic table behind a generator, you will find a [Nikola Tesla and You](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357162) skill book.
- Head out of the tunnel to [The Citadel](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356911) and listen to the conversation between Dr. Li and the Brotherhood of Steel.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 700 XP

**Next Quest:** [Picking Up the Trail](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357080)

locations.title: Picking Up the Trail
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [The Waters of Life](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357079)

**Quest Steps:**
- After [Dr. Li](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357094) talks to Elder Lyons, head inside [The Citadel](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356911) and speak with [Elder Lyons](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357163).
   - After speaking with Elder Lyons, you may also ask him to train you to wear power armor.
- Head to The Citadel laboratory and get permission from Scribe Rothchild to use the Vault-Tec computer terminal in the archives.
   - Inside the lab's bathroom, in one of the stalls, you can find a [Duck and Cover!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357164) skill book on a crate.
- Head to The Citadel's archive room and use the computer, learning that [Vault 87](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356824) was given a G.E.C.K.
   - While in the A Ring of The Citadel, head to the room called 'the den' to find a [Guns and Bullets](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357165) skill book under one of the beds.
- Head back to the courtyard and speak again with Scribe Rothchild to learn more about Vault 87, highlighting that the only way in is through the settlement of [Little Lamplight](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356825).
- Head to Little Lamplight and speak with [Mayor MacCready](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357167).
   - To get into Little Lamplight, you may either:
      - Pass a speech check.
      - Use the speech option only unlocked with the Child at Heart perk.
      - Complete the side quest [Rescue from Paradise](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357166)
- Once in Little Lamplight, there are two ways to gain access to Vault 87:
   - Get permission and head into Murder Pass, filled with super mutants
   - Speak to Mayor MacCready about other ways into the vault, revealing a back door to the vault inside of Little Lamplight. Then, speak to Joseph about restoring the power to the terminal outside the door and hack the door to gain access (at least 50 Science required).

**Quest Rewards:**
- 800 XP

**Next Quest:** [Finding the Garden of Eden](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357081)

locations.title: Finding the Garden of Eden
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Picking Up the Trail](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357080)

**Quest Steps:**
- After heading into [Vault 87](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356824), make your way through the vault until you come across the test labs, containing [Fawkes](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357168).
- Here, you have two choices:
   - Free Fawkes, which will allow him to go into the heavily irradiated area and acquire the G.E.C.K for you while fighting off super mutants. This will also allow Fawkes to become a companion later.
   - Head into the heavily irradiated area yourself and grab the G.E.C.K.
- After grabbing the G.E.C.K., start to make your way out of the vault where you will be ambushed and incapacitated.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 1,000 XP

**Next Quest:** [The American Dream](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357082)

locations.title: The American Dream
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [Finding the Garden of Eden](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357081)

**Quest Steps:**
- After waking up, speak with Colonel Autumn, where you are given the options to:
   - Give him the access code to Project Purity, where he then proceeds to kill you
   - Refuse to give him the code
   - Give him a fake code, which causes one of his soldiers to get killed.
- After talking with Colonel Autumn, [President John Henry Eden](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357169) will wish to speak with you.
- Head out of your cell and make your way through the base, fighting Enclave soldiers as you go.
- Eventually, once you make your way to the second floor, Colonel Autumn will instruct every Enclave solider to turn on you.
- Fight through the second floor to the control room containing President Eden.
   - On the second floor in section 2C, follow the hallway down and take the left door to find Colonel Autumn's room, containing the [Bobblehead - Energy Weapons](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357170) on a table and the [ZAX Destruct Sequence](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357171) holotape in a locked footlocker. These must be grabbed before heading into the control room.
- Speak to President Eden, where he will give you a modified FEV to contaminate Project Purity.
- After he gives it to you, there are a few ways to proceed:
   - You may convince Eden to self-destruct himself and Raven Rock with a speech check.
   - You may convince Eden to self-destruct himself and Raven Rock with a science check of 60 or higher.
   - If you grabbed the holotape ZAX Destruct Sequence before entering the control room, you may use that to cause Eden to self-destruct himself and Raven Rock.
   - You may leave him alone and leave Raven Rock.
- No matter the choice, start to head through the base to leave, fighting Enclave soldiers as you go.
   - On your way out of the base, you will come across an area with a crate behind a forcefield. In the crate, you may find a [Gatling Laser](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357172)
- Once out of the base, you will find [Fawkes](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357168) battling some Enclave soldiers, if you saved him from [Vault 87](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356824). Here, you may acquire him as a companion if you have good karma.
- Next, head back to [The Citadel](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356911) and speak with the group there who are discussing taking back Project Purity.
   - At this point, you may give [Elder Lyons](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357163) the modified FEV, netting you good karma.
- Speak to Sarah next who will then offer you the option of either a suit of [Power Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357173) or a set of [Recon Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357174)
- Finally, Sarah will ask whether you are ready to take back the [Jefferson Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356909).
   - This is the point of no return for the base game without the Broken Steel DLC. This is also the point of no return depending on your choice at the end of the game.

**Quest Rewards:**
- [Power Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357173) or [Recon Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357174)

**Next Quest:** [Take it Back!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357083) / [Project Impurity](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357084)

locations.title: Take it Back!
locations.description:
**Previous Quest:** [The American Dream](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357082)

**Quest Steps:**
- After starting this quest, make your way out of [The Citadel](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356911) and follow Liberty Prime towards the [Jefferson Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356909), killing the Enclave defending it along the way.
- Head inside the memorial and go straight to the control room, where you will find Colonel Autumn waiting for you.
- You may either:
   - Convince Colonel Autumn to not attack you through a series of speech checks.
   - Kill Colonel Autumn
- Afterwards, head up the stairs, where you learn the Project Purity will self destruct soon if someone doesn't manually start the purify, but to enter the area to start the purify would give them a lethal dose of radiation.
- In the base game, you may either:
   - Contaminate the water with the modified FEV, which will complete the quest [Project Impurity](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357084) and end the game
   - Sacrifice yourself by going in there and activating the purifier, ending the game
   - Sacrifice Sarah Lyons to go in there, ending the game
   - Do nothing, allowing the purifier to explode, ending the game
- With the Broken Steel DLC, there are more options:
   - After sacrificing yourself or Sarah Lyons, or if you contaminate Project Purity, the game will not end, but actually start the Broken Steel DLC.
   - You may also instead send in one of your radiation-resistant companions to do it instead: [Fawkes](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357168), Charon, or Sergeant RL-3. This will not kill the player and the game will then lead into the Broken Steel DLC.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 1,200 XP
- If you decide to kill Colonel Autumn during the quest, you may also loot off his body:
   - [Colonel Autumn's Uniform](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357176)
   - [Colonel Autumn's Laser Pistol](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357175)

locations.description:
_**Note:** This quest will fail if the player chooses not to use the modified FEV, or if you choose to give [Elder Lyons](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357163) the modified FEV during the main quest [The American Dream](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357082)._

locations.description:

**Quest Steps:**

- Fight your way through the museum to the west wing to make it to the Virgo II Lunar Lander and take the radio dish.
- Exit the museum and make your way to the [The Washington Monument](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356892).
- Take the elevator up the monument, using the password given by [Three Dog](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357095) to unlock the security doors, and mount the radio dish to the top of the monument.
- Return to Three Dog and let him know the new dish is installed.
