locations.title: Agatha's Song
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Agatha](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357088) in [Agatha's House](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356813).

**Quest Steps:**
- Speak to Agatha about her lost Soil Stradivarius.
- Optional:
   - Locate the [Vault-Tec Headquarters](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356840).
   - Discover the location of [Vault 92](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356778) from the [Vault-Tec Vault Information](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378774) holotape.
- Retrieve the Soil Stradivarius from [Vault 92](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356778).
- Endings:
   - Return to Agatha.
   - Find a buyer for the Soil Stradivarius.
      - The violin can be sold to [Ahzrukhal](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357086) in [The Underworld](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356891) for 200-300 Caps
      - The violin can be sold to [Abraham Washington](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357087) in Rivet City for 200-300 Caps, which will also yield karma. However, if you mention this to Agatha, it's possible to buy the violin back from Abraham and return it to Agatha.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 300+ XP
- Agatha's Radio Station OR 200-300 Caps

**Quest Notes:** You may also return sheet music to Agatha that can be found throughout the wasteland. When doing so, she will give the player the [Blackhawk](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357089) weapon as a reward.

locations.title: Rescue from Paradise
locations.description:
**Quest Steps:**
- Speak with Mayor MacCready inside of [Little Lamplight](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356825) to learn about the enslaved children at [Paradise Falls](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356801).
   - This can be skipped by heading straight to Paradise Falls and talking with Sammy.
- Head to Paradise Falls and head to the back. You'll see a caged off section containing Sammy and his friends locked up.
- There are two different ways to save the kids:
   - You may kill all the slavers.
   - You may work with Squirrel to connect his terminal to the network so they may disable their slave collars.
- After freeing the kids, one of the kids, Penny, refuses to leave without their friend Rory, who is locked up in 'the box'.
   - If the player decides to kill all the slavers, it is impossible to save Rory, as he will be killed.
- There are a few ways to go about helping Penny:
   - You may convince her to leave Rory behind with a speech check or with the Child at Heart perk.
   - You may get the key to 'the box' by either pickpocketing [Eulogy Jones](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368839) or by stealing it from Eulogy's Pad.
- Since Rory isn't a child, he is unable to sneak out with the kids, therefore he must be guided out by the player or left to find his way out himself. It is not necessary to keep him alive to complete the quest.
- Once the kids are out, go back and meet the children at Paradise Falls

**Quest Rewards:**
- 900 XP
- Entry to Little Lamplight, if the player hasn't unlocked it already through speech checks
- Option to head to [Vault 87](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356824) through the back door

**Quest Notes:** There are many different ways to handle completing this quest and saving everyone, but the only necessary part needed to complete the quest is to save the children.

locations.title: Big Trouble in Big Town
locations.description:
**How to start:** Either talk to anyone in [Big Town](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356833), speak to Sticky in [Little Lamplight](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356825), or speak to [Red](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357178) in [Germantown](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356802)

**Quest Steps:**
- Head to Germantown and enter the Germantown Police HQ.
   - You may either enter via the unlocked northern door or the locked western door (requires 100 Lockpick).
- Find the cell where Red is held captive in and unlock it by either:
   - Lockpicking the cell door
   - Using the Germantown jailors key, which can be looted from the corpse of the strongest super mutant in the police HQ
   - Use the [Password for Lockdown Computer](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357179) on the lockdown terminal to unlock Red's cell
- Optional:
   - The player may go and also help Red's friend, Shorty, who is held captive down in the kitchen.
- If at any point Red dies during the quest, the player must go back to Big Town to explain how they died.
- If the player successfully saves Red, go back to Big Town and speak with her.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If Red dies during the quest:
   - 200 caps
- If Red lives during the quest:
   - 300 XP
   - Good karma if the player chooses not to accept a reward
   - 300 caps if the player chooses a reward
   - 500 caps and bad karma if the player chooses a reward and passes a speech check for more caps

locations.title: Blood Ties
locations.description:
**How to start:**
- Speak to Lucy West in [Megaton](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356859)
- Speak to [Evan King](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357181) in [Arefu](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356818)

**Quest Steps:**
- If the player receives the quest from Lucy West, they will also receive a letter to deliver to the West family and will be directed to head to Arefu.
- Head to Arefu and speak with Evan King, who informs them about the repeated attacks on the town by The Family.
- Check the Ewer, Schenzy, and West family homes in the town to ensure they are safe.
   - Upon checking on the West residence, they will found that the West family is dead. Depending on the player's Medicine skill, they can determine different things from the bodies:
      - 30+ Medicine Skill: There are bite marks on their necks
      - 50+ Medicine Skill: They have suffered a large amount of blood loss
      - 70+ Medicine Skill: The bite marks were made by human teeth
      - 90+ Medicine Skill: There is train yard residue on the bodies.
- Report back to Evan King, who will notice that Ian West is missing. If asked, he will give three different locations to check for 'The Family':
   - [Hamilton's Hideaway](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356816)
   - [Moonbeam Outdoor Cinema](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356832)
   - [Northwest Seneca Station](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356817)
   - If the player passed the 90+ Medicine skill and discovered the train yard residue, Evan will also add the [Meresti Trainyard](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356814) to their map also, which is actually where the family resides. 
      - You may also find out this information by speaking to [Murphy](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378366) at the Northwest Seneca Station, who tells the player to follow the sewers.
- Head to the Meresti Metro station, either through the tunnels near Murphy's house in Northwest Seneca Station or by the tunnels under the Meresti Trainyard.
- Approach the gate to 'The Family' hideout and speak with Robert, where you can gain entry by either:
   - Giving him 100 caps
   - Show him Lucy's letter for Ian
   - Pass a speech check
   - Choose the special speech option given by the Cannibal perk
- To gain entry into Ian's meditation room, the player may either:
   - Follow a series of conversations with the different members of 'The Family'
   - Convince [Vance](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357183) to give the passcode via a Speech check
   - Kill the family
- After gaining access and finding Ian, you may either convince him to leave 'The Family' and leave him there.
- Head to Vance (if he was not killed earlier) and tell him about Ian's decision.
   - Here, you can also broker a deal with Vance to either stop attacking Arefu or to defend Arefu.
- Return to Arefu and speak to Evan King about Ian (and the deal if a deal has been made).

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player either killed Vance and looted his body or struck a deal between 'The Family' and Arefu:
   - [Schematics - Shishkebab](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357182)

**Quest Notes:** You can return to Vance after this quest is complete, if he is still alive and if you had brokered a deal, to receive the Hematophage perk.

locations.title: Head of State
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Hannibal Hamlin](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357188) in the [Temple of the Union](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356805)
- Speak to [Leroy Walker](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357189) in the [Lincoln Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356883)
- Kill the slavers in the Lincoln Memorial

**Quest Steps:**
- If you speak to Hannibal and decide to side with the slaves:
   - The player will be asked to scout out the Lincoln Memorial for super mutants.
      - Head to the Lincoln Memorial and discover that slavers have taken it over.
      - Kill all the slavers occupying the memorial.
      - The player may also inform the slavers of the location of the runaway slaves.
   - The player will also be asked to supply a picture of the Lincoln Memorial before it was destroyed.
      - Speak with Caleb Smith, a stonemason looking to repair the memorial.
      - Head to the [Museum of History](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356891) and enter it.
      - Head up the stairs towards the top layer of the museum in the office area. The Lincoln Memorial poster is on a wall next to a desk.
      - Return to Hannibal with the news of the clearance and image.
      - Escort Hannibal and the slaves to the Lincoln Memorial.
         - If the slavers were all killed and the slaves were escorted safely, the quest will end here.
         - If the slavers are still at the Lincoln Memorial when the slaves arrive and the player doesn't tell Hannibal that they will go investigate it, a battle will start, possibly causing the quest to fail if Hannibal dies.

- If you speak to Leroy and decide to side with the slavers:
   - You will need to speak with him twice for the option to help locate Hannibal Hamlin to come up.
   - After the player has been to the Temple of the Union, they may then tell Leroy about the location.
   - Leroy and the slavers will then head out to the highway to the west of the temple.
   - Once they arrive, speak with Leroy to start the attack.
      - Leroy can die during this fight, causing the quest to fail.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player sided with Hamlin and the slavers:
   - [Schematics - Dart Gun](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357191)

**Quest Notes:** If the player gives Leroy Walker a single one of Lincoln's artifacts, the other slavers at the Lincoln Memorial won't attack you.

locations.title: Oasis
locations.description:
**How to start:** Approach [Oasis](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356775) and speak to [Tree Father Birch](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357194)

**Quest Steps:**
- Talk to Tree Father Birch and agree to follow him into a hut in the village.
- Start the ritual by drinking the sap given to you by Birch.
- After the ritual, you'll wake up and speak to Harold, a mutant-turned-tree, that's being overwhelmed by a parasite named Bob.
- Listen to the Treeminders, then listen to the argument between Birch and [Leaf Mother Laurel](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357195).
- Optional:
   - Speak to Sapling Yew and pass a speech check after asking about her god, letting the player know of Harold's fear of fire.
   - Speak to Branchtender Maple, Branchtender Cypress, Bloomseer Poplar, and Branchtender Linden to learn more about them and the Oasis.
- Head into the cave system in the Oasis by either picking the lock (Lockpicking 100 required) or by getting the key from Branchtender Cypress.
- Head through the cave system until you reach Harold's heart.
   - In the cave system, you'll find a box underneath a baseball clove near a table that contains a [D.C. Journal of Internal Medicine](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357196) skill book.
- Once you arrive at Harold's heart, you have three options:
   - Apply Birch's Sap to stop Harold's growth.
   - Apply Laurel's Liniment to accelerate Harold's growth.
   - Destroy Harold's heart.
      - If the player decides to destroy Harold's heart, they will immediately receive the Barkskin perk.
- No matter the choice the player makes, head through the nearby door back to the grove and speak to either Birch or Laurel.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player used the sap on Harold's Heart:
   - [Maple's Garb](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357197)
   - [Missile Launcher](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357198)
   - x2 Missiles
- If the player used the liniment on Harold's heart:
   - [Poplar's Hood](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357199)
   - [Linden's Outcast Power Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357200)
- If the player destroyed Harold's heart:
   - Barkskin perk
- If the player passed the speech check with Sapling Yew before entering the cave:
   - Sapling Yew's Charm, increasing the players Speech by 10 permanently

**Quest Notes:** The player may also choose to burn down Harold with a fire weapon, causing the quest to fail and the Oasis to become hostile.

locations.title: Reilly's Rangers
locations.description:
**How to start:**
- Speak to [Reilly](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357329) in [The Underworld](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356891) after healing her via a speech check or a medicine check.
- Listen to the Ranger Emergency Frequency station near the [The Statesman Hotel](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356843) or the [The National Archives](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356899)
- Head straight to The Statesman Hotel and speak to the Rangers on the roof.

**Quest Steps:**
- Head to The Statesman Hotel and make your way to the roof.
   - On the first stairwell of the hotel, there is an ammunition box near a dead Ranger. It can only be opened if the player spoke to Reilly and received the ammunition cache code.
- Speak to [Butcher](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378413) on the roof, where he will tell the player that they can't leave until the elevator is repaired, requiring a fission battery.
- The player may either:
   - Give Butcher a fission core to repair the elevator.
      - If the player doesn't have one, one can be looted from a broken protectron in the hotel's restaurant.
   - With a Repair skill of 75 or more and a fission core, the player may fix the elevator themselves.
- Fight your way out of the hotel with the rangers.
- Head to The Ranger Compound and speak to Reilly.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- The player can choose either:
   - [Ranger Battle Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357330)
   - [Eugene](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357331)

**Quest Notes:** If all of the rangers at the hotel die, the player will not be able to start the unmarked quest [Geomapping with Reilly](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357332)

locations.title: Stealing Independence
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Abraham Washington](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357087) in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)
- Head straight to the [The National Archives](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356899) and speak with [Sydney](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357334)

**Quest Steps:**
- After entering The National Archive, in the first main room, you'll find Sydney, another person hired by Abraham to get the Declaration of Independence. Here, you can either help Sydney or reject her help and go on alone.
   - It is advisable to take Sydney with you, as you can later get [Sydney's 10mm "Ultra" SMG](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357335) at the end of the quest
- Fight your way through the archives until you reach the Declaration of Independence and speak with the robot Button Gwinnett.
- Button will request the player gather materials to forge the Declaration of Independence instead of taking it.
- The player may choose to either:
   - Kill Button, causing more robots to attack.
   - Agree to help him, requiring the player to head to the [Arlington Library](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356913) and acquiring an ink container. Once given to Button, he will give you a forged version of the Declaration of Independence.
      - The player may then tell Button to either self destruct or to stay and guard the document.
   - Pass a speech check, convincing Button that the player character is Thomas Jefferson. Doing this, the player may grab the real Declaration of Independence and Button with deactivate.
   - Order Button to deactivate, if the player has the Robotics Expert perk.
- Leave the archives and return to Abraham Washington
   - You may also grab the Bill of Rights and the Magna Carta from the archives, both of which can be sold to Abraham.
   - If the player chose to kill Button, they will have to fight a series of robots on the way out.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 330 XP
- [Schematics - Railway Rifle](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357338)
- If the player doesn't do the quest with Sydney:
   - 400 caps
- If Sydney dies and the player loots her body, or the player does the quest with Sydney and retrieved the [A Note from Little Moonbeam's Father](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357336) holotape, the player may give her the holotape, where she will reward the player with:
   - [Sydney's 10mm "Ultra" SMG](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357335)

locations.title: Strictly Business
locations.description:
**How to start:** Approach [Paradise Falls](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356801) and speak with [Grouse](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368842).

**Quest Steps:**
- Upon speaking with Grouse and accepting the quest, the player will receive a [Mesmetron](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357340), a slave collar, slave collar instructions, a [Paradise Falls](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356801) holotape, and a list of "recruits" for Paradise Falls.
- The people that the player is required to enslave are:
   - [Flak](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357342) in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)
   - [Red](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357178) in [Big Town](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356833) (Can only be done during or after completing [Big Trouble in Big Town](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357177) and if Red didn't die during that quest)
   - [Susan Lancaster](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357343) in [Tenpenny Tower](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356928)
   - [Arkansas](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357344) from [Minefield](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356804)
- The player must head to a location, capture a person with a slave collar, and return back to Paradise Falls and speak to Grouse for another slave collar until every person is captured.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 1,000 caps

**Quest Notes:** After turning in one of the people to Grouse, the player may enter Paradise Falls without issue.

locations.title: Tenpenny Tower
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Chief Gustavo](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357346) in [Tenpenny Tower](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356928)
- Speak to [Roy Phillips](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357347) in the Warrington Tunnels
- Kill every resident in Tenpenny Tower.
   - In doing so, the player can skip most of the quest, and just let Roy and the ghouls know they can move into the tower immediately.

**Quest Steps:**
- If the player speaks with Gustavo first:
   - Gustavo will give the player an assault rifle and ask the player to kill Roy Phillips and the other ghouls in Warrington Tunnels
      - If the player passes a speech check during this conversation, they will be given a Chinese Assault Rifle instead.
      - If the player tries and fails a speech check during this conversation, Gustavo will instead give the player a 10mm SMG.
   - Head to Warrington Tunnels via the [Warrington Station](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356933) or the [Warrington Trainyard](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356929).
- There are multiple ways to complete this quest:
   - Kill Roy Phillips and the ghouls in Warrington Tunnels
   - Convince the tenants of Tenpenny Tower to allow the ghouls to move into the tower with them, then speak to [Allistair Tenpenny](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378249) and Roy.
      - This can also be done by killing all the tenants in the tower.
   - Help the ghouls enter the tower through the generator room.
      - The key to the generator room can be pickpocketed or looted from Herbert Dashwood or Chief Gustavo. Otherwise, the player can also hack the terminal to the generator room, or blow up the generator, causing the door to open.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player sides with the ghouls and they move into Tenpenny Tower with the other residents:
   - [Ghoul Mask](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357352)
   - 500 caps
   - 300 XP
- If the player sides with the ghouls and leads them through the generator room:
   - [Ghoul Mask](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357352)
- If the player kills the ghouls:
   - 500 caps
      - 700 caps if the player passes a speech check with Chief Gustavo

**Quest Notes:** If the players side with the ghouls and the ghouls move into Tenpenny Tower, the unmarked quest [A Manhandled Manservant](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357350) will be unable to be completed if it wasn't completed already.

locations.title: The Nuka-Cola Challenge
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Sierra Petrovita](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357354) in her house in [Girdershade](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356865)

**Quest Steps:**
- After speaking to Sierra and agreeing to a tour, follow her to each of the exhibits she has around her home.
- She will then request the player recover 30 bottles of Nuka-Cola Quantum for her collection, rewarding 40 caps for every bottle the player gives her.
- After the player finishes talking to her, head out of her house to find [Ronald Laren](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357355) waiting for them, expressing their interest in buying the Nuka-Cola Quantum from them instead.
   - He will initially wish to buy them from the player for 40 caps each, which is the same as how much Sierra would pay the player for them, but if a speech check is passed, the player may raise the prices to 80 caps each.
   - It is advisable not to give Ronald the Nuka-Cola instead of Sierra, since the player will miss out on acquiring the [Schematics - Nuka Grenade](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357440) from Sierra.
   - If you have the Black Widow perk, you can convince Ronald to go and get the Nuka-Cola Quantum himself, which will cause him to run towards the [Nuka-Cola Plant](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356921), where he will either inside the plant or on the way.
- Head throughout the capital wasteland and acquire 30 Nuka-Cola Quantums.
- Return to Girdershade and turn in the Nuka-Cola Quantums to either Sierra or Ronald.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player gives the Nuka-Cola Quantums to Sierra:
   - 300 XP
   - 1,200 caps
   - [Schematics - Nuka Grenade](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357440)
   - The ability to receive Mississippi Quantum pies from the repeatable quest [Mississippi Quantum Pie](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378365)
- If the player gives the Nuka-Cola Quantums to Ronald:
   - 1,200 caps (2,400 if the player passes a speech check)

locations.title: The Power of the Atom
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Sheriff Lucas Simms](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357442) about disarming the bomb in [Megaton](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356859).
- Speak to [Mister Burke](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357443) about blowing up the bomb in Megaton
- Interacting with the bomb and disarm it (25+ Explosives skill required).

**Quest Steps:**
- This quest can be completed in two different ways:
   - Disarming the Bomb
      - Speak with Lucas Simms about disarming the bomb
      - Head to the nuclear bomb resting in the middle of Megaton.
      - Interact with it with an Explosives skill of 25+ or higher and disarm it.
      - Return to Lucas Simms.
   - Rigging the Bomb
      - Speak with Mister Burke in Moriarty's Saloon about rigging the bomb to explode, acquiring the fusion pulse charge.
      - Interact with the nuclear bomb and rig the fusion pulse charge to it.
      - Head to [Tenpenny Tower](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356928) and speak to Mister Burke in the penthouse suite.
      - Blow up Megaton!

**Quest Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- If the bomb in Megaton is disarmed:
   - 100 caps (500 caps if a speech check is passed at the beginning of the quest when speaking to Lucas
   - [My Megaton House](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357444)
- If Megaton is blown up:
   - 500 caps (1,000 caps if a speech check is passed at the beginning of the quest when speaking to Mister Burke)
   - [Tenpenny Tower Suite](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357445)

**Quest Notes:** The player may also turn in Mister Burke to Lucas Simms after speaking with Burke. This will cause Lucas to go to Moriarty's Saloon and try to arrest Burke, which will end with them fighting. One of them will die during this exchange.

locations.title: The Replicated Man
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak with [Dr. Zimmer](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357448) in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)
- Find one of the [Replicated Man Holotapes](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?search=Replicated+Man+Holotape+%26%26+category%3A11140)

**Quest Steps:**
- Speak with Dr. Zimmer in Rivet City about an android that escaped the Commonwealth and fled to the Capital Wasteland.
- Find and collect a total of four [Replicated Man Holotapes](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?search=Replicated+Man+Holotape+%26%26+category%3A11140) from different towns across the wasteland.
   - During any part of this quest, the player may come across Victoria Watts. She will explain that she is a part of the Railroad, working to protect runaway androids, and wants you to tell Dr. Zimmer that the android is dead. She will give you a piece of the android's body as proof. You may then head to Dr. Zimmer and tell him this, ending the quest
- Once the player listens to the holotapes, they will need to head to Horace Pinkerton in Rivet City to find the android's whereabouts, revealing that Harkness, the security chief of Rivet City, is the android. 
- There a multiple ways to carry on with the quest:
   - Lie to Dr. Zimmer than the android is dead using the part given to you by Victoria Watts.
   - Tell Harkness that he is an android, then:
      - Tell him that you won't tell anyone his secret.
      - Let him plan to kill Dr. Zimmer
      - Tell him that the player is willing to kill Dr. Zimmer for him
      - Convince him to go with Dr. Zimmer
   - Tell Dr. Zimmer who the android is.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- If the player either kills Dr. Zimmer for Harkness or tells Harkness that their secret is safe with them:
   - [A3-21's Plasma Rifle](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369354)
- If the player lies to Dr. Zimmer about the android being dead:
   - 50 caps
- If the player reveals to Dr. Zimmer that Harkness is the android:
   - The Wired Reflexes perk

locations.title: The Superhuman Gambit
locations.description:
**How to start:** Approach and watch the interaction in [Canterbury Commons](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356807), then speak to [Uncle Roe](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378339)

**Quest Steps:**
- Both sides of the quest are done close to the same, and both or either can be done to complete the quest:
   - Either head to the [AntAgonizer's Lair](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356806) to confront [AntAgonizer](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369357) or head to the [Robot Repair Center](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356808) to confront [Mechanist](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369358)
   - If the player is wearing the other one's costume, then AntAgonizer or the Mechanist will attack.
   - If the player has the other one's costume in their inventory and are not wearing it, they may give it to the AntAgonizer or the Mechanist to receive a unique weapon.
   - The player may choose to kill either or both of the superhumans.
   - The player may choose to side with one of them, causing the other to barge in and attack them.
   - The player may also choose to convince either or both of them to quit the superhero/supervillian life, giving the player their costume
- Speak to Uncle Roe after you've done any of the above.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 200 caps per superhumans stopped (400 caps if a speech check was passed with Uncle Roe)
- If the player kills AntAgonizer or convinces them to quit:
   - [The AntAgonizer's Costume](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369361)
- If the player gives AntAgonizer the Mechanist's costume:
   - [Ant's String](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369362)
- If the player kills Mechanist or convinces them to quit:
   - [The Mechanist's Costume](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369360)
- If the player gives Mechanist the AntAgonizer's costume:
   - [Protectron's Gaze](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369359)

locations.title: Wasteland Survival Guide
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Moira Brown](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368830) in the Craterside Supply in [Megaton](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356859)

**Quest Steps:**
- There are three sections in the quest, with three objectives per section:
   - Section 1:
      1. Head to the [Super-Duper Mart](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356856) and loot the food found in the refrigerator in one of the first rooms in the supermarket.
         - The player may also push through the raiders to get to a room in the back to acquire the medicine for the optional objective.
      2. Become infected with at least 200 rads. The easiest way is to head to the Megaton bomb, stand next to it, and drink the irradiated water
         - The player may also build up their rads over 600 for the optional objective.
      3. Head to the center of [Minefield](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356804) into the playground.
         - The player may also disarm and pick up a mine to turn into Moira for the optional objective
   - Section 2:
      1. Use the mole rat on three mole rats throughout the wasteland.
         - The player may also use it on a total of ten mole rats or more for the optional objective
      2. Place the observer unit given by Moira in a mirelurk egg inside the [Anchorage Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356878)
         - The player must do this without killing a mirelurk to complete the optional objective.
      3. Return to Moira with less that 50% health.
         - The player must also return to her with a crippled limb for the optional objective.
   - Section 3:
      1. Head to [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907) and speak with the citizens there to learn the history of Rivet City.
         - The player must speak to more citizens or read through terminals throughout the city to complete the optional objective.
      2. Head to [RobCo Facility](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356927) and install the processor widget given from Moira into the facility's mainframe.
         - The player must also hack the mainframe for the optional objective.
      3. Head to [Arlington Library](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356913) and retrieve the library data.
         - The player must retrieve the complete library archive for the optional objective.
- The player may also convince Moira to stop working on the book, requiring a speech check, which will end the quest.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player completes the book:
   - 100 XP
   - Mini Nuke
   - The Wasteland Survival Guide
   - The Survival Expert Perk
- If the player convinced Moira to drop the book:
   - The Dream Crusher Perk
- If the player completes the objective:
   - **Section 1: Super-Duper Mart**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Iguana Bits
      - Optional Rewards:
         - Food Sanitizer
   - **Section 1: Radiation**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Rad-X
         - RadAway
      - Optional Rewards:
         - The Rad Regeneration Perk
   - **Section 1: Minefield**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Frag Grenades
      - Optional Rewards:
         - [Schematics - Bottlecap Mine](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369390)
   - **Section 1 Completion:**
      - 100 XP
      - Stimpaks
   - **Section 2: Mole Rat**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Jet
         - Psycho
      - Optional Rewards:
         - [Repellent Stick](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369394)
   - **Section 2: Mirelurk**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Stealth Boys
      - Optional Rewards:
         - [Shady Hat](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369398)
   - **Section 2: Healing**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Med-X
      - Optional Rewards
         - [Environment Suit](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369399)
   - **Section 2 Completion:**
      - 100 XP
      - Ammo
   - **Section 3: Rivet City**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Mentats
      - Optional Rewards:
         - Permanent 10% Discount in Rivet City
   - **Section 3: RobCo Facility**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Pulse Grenades
      - Optional Rewards:
         - [Big Book of Science](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369404)
   - **Section 3: Arlington Library**
      - Normal Rewards:
         - Caps
      - Optional Rewards:
         - [Lying, Congressional Style](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369408)

locations.title: Those!
locations.description:
**How to start:** Approach [Grayditch](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356871) and speak with [Bryan Wilks](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369413)

**Quest Steps:**
- After speaking with Bryan, head into the city and look for a house near a diner and a billboard.
- Enter Bryan's house to discover his father's corpse, and then head to the shack next to their house to find a note in the terminal from [Doctor Lesko](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369416), explaining he moved his research on fire ants to the [Marigold Station](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356872).
- Head to Marigold Station to find and speak to Doctor Lesko.
- Here, the player may:
   - Kill the fire ant nest guardians protecting the fire ant queen and return to Doctor Lesko.
   - Kill the fire ant queen and convince Doctor Lesko that it's the best for the wasteland.
   - Hack the terminal near the queen to kill all the fire ants in the Grayditch area.
   - Hack Doctor Lesko's terminal to destroy the FEV then convince him it was the best for the wasteland.
   - Kill Doctor Lesko.
- After making your choice, head back to Bryan Wilks and let him know what happened.
   - Here, you may also help him find a place to stay, such as:
      - With his cousin in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907), [Vera Weatherly](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378409)
      - With the other children in [Little Lamplight](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356825), where the player must speak with [Mayor MacCready](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357167) first
      - Give him to [Eulogy Jones](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368839) in [Paradise Falls](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356801) in exchange for payment

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player says they will help Doctor Lesko, but needs serious incentive:
   - [Lesko's Lab Coat](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369425)
- If the player helps Doctor Lesko:
   - The Ant Might Perk or the Ant Sight Perk
- If the player sends Bryan to Vera Weatherly:
   - 300 XP

locations.title: Trouble on the Homefront
locations.description:
**How to start:** Fourteen days after completing [The Waters of Life](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357079), head near [Vault 101](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356860) and listen to the Vault 101 Distress Signal.

**Quest Steps:**
- Enter the vault and speak to the vault dwellers, learning that the vault has been split in two, with one side wanting to keep the vault shut, while the other wants to be able to leave the vault when they'd like to.
- To keep the vault closed, the player will have to either:
   - Ignore the radio message entirely, which will end after a few days.
   - Kill [Amata](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357091) and/or the rebels.
   - Persuade Amada to not open the vault, either by completing a speech check, or by hacking into the overseer's terminal and informing her that the Enclave has been wanting to enter the vault, proving that it could be a danger to open the vault.
- To open the vault, the player will have to either:
   - Kill the Overseer
      - If the player killed Amata's dad during [Escape!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357074), the overseer will instead be Allen Mack.
   - Convince the Overseer to step down from his role and have Amata take their place by either passing a speech check or by going to the security office's terminal and reading the note, proving that the security guards are going to assault the rebels against the Overseer's orders
- The player may also destroy the vault by hacking into the maintenance computer in the basement of the vault, or by stealing the [Vault 101 Maintenance Password](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369459) from Stanley, then flush the water chip, causing a system failure, which will force everyone to leave the vault.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- If the player sides with the Overseer and keeps the vault closed:
   - [Modified Utility Jumpsuit](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369460)
- If the player destroys the vault or convinces the Overseer to step down:
   - The ability to recruit [Butch DeLoria](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=369461) as a companion

locations.title: You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Mister Crowley](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378246)

**Quest Steps:**
- During the conversation, Mister Crowley will give the player a sniper rifle and ask the player to kill:
   - [Dave](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378242) in [The Republic of Dave](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356781) (or in [Old Olney](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356779) depending on the player's choices in the unmarked quest [Election Day](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378243)
   - [Dukov](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378247) in [Dukov's Place](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356881)
   - [Ted Strayer](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378248) in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)
   - [Allistair Tenpenny](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378249) in [Tenpenny Tower](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356928)
- If the player speaks to multiple ghouls around The Underworld, they will learn the Crowley might not be doing it due to the target's hate for ghouls. 
   - Speaking to Crowley again, the player will learn that he just needs the keys for each person, except Allistair Tenpenny, and he'll raise the reward for each kill and key.
   - Passing a speech check, the player will also learn the Crowley is looking to get the [T-51b Power Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378250) from [Fort Constantine](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356772).
- The player may go to each target and kill them, regardless if it's a headshot or not, and get the key.
   - Crowley's target, Jeff Strayer is actually dead, and his son, Ted Strayer, has the key. The player doesn't need to kill Ted and can instead threaten or convince Ted to give the key with a speech check.
   - Dukov will give the player the key through intimidating him with a speech check, persuading him with the Black Widow perk, persuade Fantasia to get the key with the Lady Killer perk, or pass a speech check with Cherry to get the key in exchange for helping her get to [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907).
   - Dave will give the player the key through a speech check.
   - Allistair Tenpenny can be informed that the player is there to kill him for Crowley, where then Tenpenny will give the player an offer to kill Crowley instead. If the player kills Crowley and returns to Tenpenny, the quest will end.
- Once the player has gathered all the keys, they may either:
   - Go and get the armor themselves
   - Give Crowley the keys and let him take the armor

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player doesn't investigate Crowley, kills each person, and returns the keys to Crowley:
   - 100 caps per person (25 if the person was not killed with a headshot)
- If the player investigates Crowley and convinces him to pay more, kills each person, and returns the keys to Crowley:
   - 100 caps, then 100 caps per key
- If the person sides with Tenpenny and agrees to kill Crowley:
   - 100 caps
- If the player takes the power armor for themselves:
   - [T-51b Power Armor](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378250)

locations.title: Geomapping with Reilly
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to Reilly after finishing the side quest [Reilly's Rangers](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357328)

**Quest Steps:**
- Speak to [Reilly](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357329), where she will give the player a Geomapper Module to track the locations the player discovers.
- Head to and discover different locations throughout the wasteland.
- Head back and speak to Reilly for a reward.
   - This can be done multiple times.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 30 caps for each location discovered

**Quest Notes:** The player must actually visit the location for it to count as discovered. The Explorer perk won't count as discovering the locations. The player may also speak to Reilly right after taking the quest to turn in the locations the player has already discovered.

locations.title: A Manhandled Manservant
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Herbert Dashwood](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357349) about manservant Argyle, who hasn't been seen since he escaped [Rockopolis](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357351)
   - This must be completed before or during the quest [Tenpenny Tower](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357345)

**Quest Steps:**
- After speaking with Herbert, head to Rockopolis.
- Once inside Rockopolis, you will discover Argyle's corpse.
- Head back to Herbert and tell him the news.

**Quest Rewards:**
- Herbert's Safe Key, where the safe contains:
   - Mentats
   - A Mini Nuke
   - Rad-X
   - A Stealth Boy
   - A Stimpak
   - [Schematics - Bottlecap Mine](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357348)

locations.title: Election Day
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Dave](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378242) in [The Republic of Dave](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356781)

**Quest Steps:**
- Speak to all of the adults in The Republic of Dave.
   - You may also convince the adults Rosie or Bob to run against Dave in the election.
   - Dave will always win, unless the player lockpicks the ballet box and changes the amount of ballets for Dave, allowing another contender to win.
- Speak to Dave and let him know that all the ballets are in. 

**Quest Rewards:**
- 25 caps
- If Dave lost the election and the player speaks with the winner of the election:
   - Dave's Safe Key, which unlocks Dave's Safe, containing:
      - [Ol' Painless](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378244)

**Quest Notes:** If Dave loses the election, he will move to [Old Olney](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356779).

locations.title: 300 Pieces of Silver
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Colin Moriarty](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357097) in [Megaton](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356859) about your dad and mention that you don't have the caps to pay him for information
- Speak to [Silver](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357098) in [Springvale](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356858) about her debt to Moriarty

**Quest Steps:**
- The player may either:
   - Kill Silver and take the 400 caps from her body
   - Pass a speech check with Silver and convince her to give the player 400 caps, in exchange that the player will tell Moriarty that Silver is dead
   - Convince Silver to give the player 300 caps, in exchange that the player will tell Moriarty that Silver is dead.
   - Tell Moriarty that Silver is gone. However, Moriarty will still insist on caps for information about their father.

**Quest Rewards:**
- Caps, depending on the choices made
- Information about the player's dad

**Quest Notes:** This quest is entirely optional, as the player can pay Moriarty without ever discussing Silver.

locations.title: A Nice Day for a Right Wedding
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Angela Staley](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378263) in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)

**Quest Steps:**
- Angela will request the player to bring ant queen pheromones to seduce her love Diego, who is planning on becoming a priest for the church.
- Gather ant queen pheromones from the wasteland and bring them to Angela.
- After giving her the pheromones, speak with her, [Vera Weatherly](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378409), or her father, [Gary Staley](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378397), and they will mention that Angela and Diego's wedding will be at 3pm that day.
- Head to the church at 3pm and take a seat to observe the wedding.

**Quest Rewards:**
- +100 Karma

**Quest Notes:** The player may also lie to [Father Clifford](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368848) that Angela and Diego are sleeping together. Diego will then be kicked out of the church, but there will be no wedding ceremony.

locations.title: Happy Birthday to You
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Sticky](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378294) in [Little Lamplight](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356825)

**Quest Steps:**
- Escort Sticky from Little Lamplight to [Big Town](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356833)

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player asks Sticky about his party hat:
   - [Party Hat](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378296)

locations.title: Council Seat
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Bannon](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378298) in the Potomac Attire in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)

**Quest Steps:**
- During the conversation, Bannon will state that he believes [Seagrave Holmes](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368833) is trying to take his city council spot and requests the player find incriminating evidence on Holmes.
- Head to Seagrave Holmes room and find the [Seagrave's Incriminating Letter](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378300) holotape at the end of his bed behind a footlocker.
- The player must then head to Lana Danvers, where they may choose to either:
   - Give Lana Danvers the evidence against Seagrave Holmes
   - Let Lana know that Bannon is trying to blackmail Holmes.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 10% discount permanently at his shop, the Potomac Attire
- 10% discount permanently at the Rivet City Supply
- If the player sides with Bannon:
   - [Schematics - Deathclaw Gauntlet](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378305)

locations.title: Economics of Violence
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Pronto](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378308) inside Lock and Load in [Paradise Falls](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356801)

**Quest Steps:**
- Speaking to Pronto, he will complain about the quality of his gear he is able to sell. He requests the player to bring him 20 Chinese Assault Rifles.
- Head out through the wasteland and acquire 20 Chinese Assault Rifles.
- Bring the Chinese Assault Rifles back to Pronto

**Quest Rewards:**
- A larger shop inventory and more caps at the Lock and Load
- 20% discount permanently at the Lock and Load

locations.title: Galllows Humor
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to the members of Lyons' Pride in the Great Hall inside [The Citadel](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356911)

**Quest Steps:**
- After speaking with the Lyons' Pride members, the player will find out that there is a betting pool for who can figure out [Knight Captain Gallows](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378309)'s real name.
- Head to Gallows and convince him to reveal his real name by passing a speech check.
- Speak to Paladin Glade and tell them Gallows real name to win the betting pool.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 1,000 caps

**Quest Notes:** Gallows real name is Irving.

locations.title: Grady's Package
locations.description:
**How to start:** Find the body of Grady inside [Marigold Station](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356872) in a manager's booth and listen to the [Grady's Last Recording](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378312) holotape

**Quest Steps:**
- In the holotape, Grady mentions hiding a key and a package in the station.
- Head down the stairs from his body, go through a tunnel on the right, and open the first door on the right to find a firehose box containing Grady's safe key.
- Continue down the tunnel and take the left tunnel until you find a room with a rotating light outside.
- Lockpick the door or unlock the door via the terminal to enter a maintenance room, containing Grady's safe.
- Open the safe and acquire the [Naughty Nightwear](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378316) inside.
- Head towards the door and the player will come into contact with Lug-Nut, a raider
- The player may:
   - Give him the nightwear
   - Keep the nightwear by passing a speech check
   - Kill him

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player decides to keep the nightwear and not deliver it:
  - [Naughty Nightwear](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378316)
- If the player decides to deliver the package to [Ronald Laren](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357355) in [Girdershade](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356865):
   - 200 caps (300 caps if the player passes a speech check)

locations.title: Hired Help
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Ahzrukhal](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357086) in [The Underworld](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356891)

**Quest Steps:**
- During the conversation with Ahzrukhal, he will state that he has the employment contract for [Charon](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378318) and is willing to give it to the player if they buy if off of them or if they kill his competitor, [Greta](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378319).
- The player may either:
   - Kill Greta
   - Pay Ahzrukhal 2,000 caps (1,000 caps if the player's Barter skill is 50 or higher)

**Quest Rewards:**
- The ability to recruit [Charon](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378318) as a companion

**Quest Notes:** After finishing this quest, Charon will approach Ahzrukhal and shoot him in the head.

locations.title: Jiggs' Loot
locations.description:
**How to start:** Head to one of the special terminals in the [Museum of Technology](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356900) and read the entry titled "#000"

**Quest Steps:**
- There will be three terminals with a special entry, from someone named Prime, in them. The first one found with have it labelled as "#000", but will switch to the appropriate number after reading the entry for the first time. Each terminal has a specific number that's required to be input. The terminals are:
   - Terminal #001: In the first room of the museum, on the wall across from the entrance
      - The password is 19.
   - Terminal #002: Just past the Vault tour, head straight and a little to the left.
      - The password is 53.
   - Terminal #003: On the wall below the Delta rocket exhibit.
      - The password is 113.
- If the player messes up and inputs the wrong password into any of the terminals, the quest cannot be continued. 
- After inputting the password into all three terminals, head to the planetarium and go west into the security office to find a safe and a terminal. Interact with the terminal and read the final entry, congratulating Jiggs on finding the passwords and unlocking the safe. The entry will also state that Prime is waiting for Jiggs in the diner near [Jury Street Metro Station](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356861).
- Loot the safe then head to the Jury Street Metro Station to find Prime dead on the floor.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 200 caps
- If the player heads to Jury Street Metro Station and loots Prime:
   - 500 caps
   - [Xuanlong Assault Rifle](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378321)

**Quest Notes:** The name Prime is a hint for the passwords for each terminal, as the correct passwords are the only prime numbers in the list.

locations.title: Just for the Taste of It
locations.description:
**Note: This quest can only be done if side quest [The Nuka-Cola Challenge](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357353) hasn't been completed yet.**

**How to start:** Loot and read the 'Finding the Formula' note off of Winger Mercier's body on the second floor of the [Nuka-Cola Plant](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356921)

**Quest Steps:**
- Reading the note, the player will learn that Winger Mercier was tasks on finding the Nuka-Cola Clear formula from the R&D lab in the Nuka-Cola plant and deliver it to [Goalie Ledoux](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378323) at the [Red Racer Factory](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356920).
- Head to the lower level of the plant and speak with Milo, a Mister Handy robot, to retrieve the safe key that contains the formula. There are a few ways to obtain the key from Milo:
   - Pass a speech check to convince him to give you the key.
   - Speak to him with the Robotics Expert perk, in which he will just give the player the key.
   - Read the note 'Welcome to the Nuka-Cola family!' in the R&D lab's computer, which gives the player an employee id, which then can be relayed to Milo.
   - Kill Milo
- Head to the front entrance of the plant and go into the first door on the left to find the safe.
- Loot the formula and head to Ledoux at the Red Racer Factory.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 250 caps (400 caps if the player passes a speech check with Ledoux)

**Quest Notes:** The player may also kill Ledoux to acquire his unique mask, [Ledoux's Hockey Mask](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378324)

locations.title: Keller Family Refuge
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Read one of the Keller Family holotapes:
   - [Keller Family Transcript 1](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378325)
   - [Keller Family Transcript 2](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378327)
   - [Keller Family Transcript 3](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378328)
   - [Keller Family Transcript 4](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378329)
   - [Keller Family Transcript 5](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378330)

**Quest Steps:**
- Go through the wasteland and read at least the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th Keller Family transcript.
   - The 1st transcript is not needed to completed this quest.
- Head to the top floor of the [National Guard Depot](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356838) and input the password from the Keller Family transcripts.
- Head back down to the armory bunker, which is now unlocked.

**Quest Rewards:**
- [Experimental MIRV](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378331)
- [U.S. Army: 30 Handy Flamethrower Recipes](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378332)

locations.title: Leo's Drug Habit
locations.description:
**How to start:** 
- Speak to [Doc Church](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357446), [Sheriff Lucas Simms](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357442), or [Mister Burke](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357443) in [Megaton](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356859) about Leo.
- Hack into [Colin Moriarty](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357097) terminal in [Moriarty's Saloon](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357096).

**Quest Steps:**
- Speak to [Leo Stahl](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378334) about his chem addiction.
- While speaking to Leo, you may either:
   - Pass a speech check to convince him to stop doing drugs
   - Start talking to him about quitting his addiction, but then don't pass the speech check, which will cause him to continue doing drugs and become a chem dealer for the player
   - Ask him what it's worth to keep quiet about his secret, which will cause him to continue doing drugs and become a chem dealer for the player.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player convinces Leo to stop using drugs:
   - Leo's Stash Key, unlocking his stash in the water treatment plant, which contains:
      - Caps
      - Buffout
      - Med-X
      - Mentats
      - Psycho
      - Stimpaks
      - Jet
- If the player doesn't convince Leo to stop using drugs
   - The ability to use Leo as a chem dealer for the player

locations.title: Lincoln's Profit Margins
locations.description:
**How to start:** Pick up one of Abraham Lincoln's belongings inside of the [Museum of History](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356891)

**Quest Steps:**
- Find all of Abraham Lincoln's belongings in the Museum of History and sell them to either [Abraham Washington](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357087), [Leroy Walker](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357189), or [Hannibal Hamlin](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357188).
- All of Lincoln's belonging's are:
   - Lincoln's Diary
      - Found in a display case up the steps in the large display room
   - Action Abe Action Figure
      - Found in the a locked room in the eastern wall to the archive room on a desk
   - John Wilkes Booth Wanted Poster
      - Found on the main floor on the third bookshelf in the farthest south-western corner of the floor
   - Civil War Draft Poster
      - Found in the offices on the first floor in the south-eastern corner on top of a bookshelf
   - Lincoln's Voice
      - Found in the offices on the second floor on top of the second desk on the left after going up the stairs
   - Lincoln Memorial Poster
      - Found in the offices on the second floor behind the first desk after going up the stairs. It won't spawn until the player has started the side quest [Head of State](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357187)
   - Antique Lincoln Coin Collection
      - Found in a room on the right side of the offices on the second floor on a bookshelf
   - [Lincoln's Repeater](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378336)
      - Found in a display case on the second floor through a hole in the wall, next to a [Chinese Army: Special Ops Training Manual](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378337) skill book
   - [Lincoln's Hat](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378338)
      - Found on the floor in a room connecting to the offices on the second floor filled with rubble


**Quest Rewards:**
- If the items aren't sold:
   - [Lincoln's Repeater](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378336)
   - [Lincoln's Hat](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378338)
- Caps, depending on who the item is sold to (all values are doubled if a speech check is passed):
   - **Lincoln's Repeater**:
      - Hannibal Hamlin: 150 caps
      - Leroy Walker or Abraham Washington: 100 caps
   - **Lincoln's Hat**:
      - Abraham Washington: 70 caps
      - Hannibal Hamlin or Leroy Walker: 25 caps
   - **Lincoln's Voice**:
      - Abraham Washington: 60 caps
      - Hannibal Hamlin or Leroy Walker: 50 caps
   - **Action Abe Action Figure**:
      - Hannibal Hamlin, Leroy Walker, or Abraham Washington: 10 caps
   - **Civil War Draft Poster**:
      - Hannibal Hamlin: 75 caps
      - Abraham Washington: 60 caps
      - Leroy Walker: 50 caps
   - **Lincoln's Diary**:
      - Hannibal Hamlin or Abraham Washington: 100 caps
      - Leroy Walker: 75 caps
   - **Antique Lincoln Coin Collection**:
      - Hannibal Hamlin, Leroy Walker, or Abraham Washington: 15 caps
   - **John Wilkes Booth Wanted Poster**:
      - Leroy Walker: 75 caps
      - Abraham Washington: 70 caps
      - Hannibal Hamlin: 50 caps
   - **Lincoln Memorial Poster**:
      - 100 caps

locations.title: Merchant Empire
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Uncle Roe](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378339) in [Canterbury Commons](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356807)

**Quest Steps:**
- While speaking to Uncle Roe, mention that you'd like to unify the caravans around the wasteland.
- The player will need to convince him using either the Master Trader perk, a high Barter skill, the Black Widow perk, or have at least 250 caps on hand, then Uncle Roe will mention that investing in the caravans would be a good idea.
   - The player can invest in each caravan twice:
       - The first time, the investment will cost 200 caps (100 caps with the Master Trader perk)
      - The second time, the investment will cost 500 caps (250 caps with the Master Trader perk)

**Quest Rewards:**
- After fully upgraded, the specific caravan will have:
   - Improved inventories
   - Improved repair ability
   - More caps on hand
- After fully upgrading and speaking to Crow:
   - [Crow's Eyebot Helmet](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378341)
- After fully upgrading and speaking to Crazy Wolfgang:
   - 2-6 Stealth Boys
- After fully upgrading and speaking to Doc Hoff: 
   - 3-7 Stimpaks
- After fully upgrading and speaking to Lucky Harith:
   - Mini Nuke

locations.title: Our Little Secret
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Old Man Harris](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378343) in [Andale](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356923)

**Quest Steps:**
- While speaking to Old Man Harris, he will warn the player to stay away from the town.
- The player will need to either head into the garden shed or the basement of the Smith's house.
   - You may either lockpick your way in (requires a 100 Lockpick skill) or to find the key. The key can be found:
      - By pickpocketing Bill Wilson or Jack Smith
      - Inside either the Smith's house or the Wilson's house, on the nightstand next to their bed
      - Inside the Wilson's house, on top of a radio in their living room
- Inside the basement or the garden shed, the player will find a strange meat, which is actually human flesh.
- Once the player leaves the room, the residents of the town will talk to the player. 
- During the dialogue, the player may choose to:
   - Pass a speech check to mention they just wanted a snack (the speech check is unneeded with the Cannibal perk)
   - Not answering straight, then pass a speech check, stating that the player won't tell anyone their secret.
   - Tell the residents that they won't keep their secret, which will turn everyone hostile (except Old Man Harris)

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player doesn't kill the residents:
   - The ability to talk to Linda Smith every day to obtain a Strange Meat Pie

locations.title: Searching for Cheryl
locations.description:
**How to start:** Find and read the 'search party log #1' note inside a burial mound in [L'Enfant South](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356908)

**Quest Steps:**
- After reading the first party log, head to the [Ranger Compound](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356904) and read the note in the terminal outside.
   - The terminal can be hacked (100 Science skill required) or the code can be given to the player during the side quest [Reilly's Rangers](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=357328)
- After reading the second party log, head to a burial mount between [Dukov's Place](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356881) and the Potomac bridge and read the third note.
- After reading the third party log, head to a grave, northwest of the [Sewer Waystation](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356870) in front of a billboard.
- Finally, to find Manny, head out to a wrecked train to the southwest of the [Jury Street Metro Station](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356861).
- In the camp, you'll find Manny's body on the ground.
   - If the player opens the shopping cart cage, a super mutant behemoth spawns.

**Quest Rewards:**
- If the player kills the super mutant behemoth:
   - Mini Nuke

locations.title: Slave Hunt
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Mei Wong](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378345) in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)

**Quest Steps:**
- Upon speaking to Mei, she will mention that she's an escaped slave and that a slaver named [Sister](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368844) is in Rivet City and she is terrified.
- The player can choose to:
   - Mesmerize Mei and send her back to [Paradise Falls](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356801).
   - Tell Sister about Mei, then tell Mei that you told Sister she's there. This will cause Mei to commit suicide.
   - Give Mei 25 caps, allowing her to buy a weapon to defend herself against Sister.
   - Kill Sister
   - Mesmerize Sister, causing him to go in a rage, eventually being killed by Rivet City security

**Quest Rewards:**
- If you help Mei:
   - The location of the [Temple of the Union](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356805)

locations.title: The Kid-Kidnapper
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Eulogy Jones](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=368839) in [Paradise Falls](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356801) after visiting [Little Lamplight](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356825)

**Quest Steps:**
- While talking to Eulogy Jones, mention that you could help kidnap one of the children in Little Lamplight.
- Head to Little Lamplight and convince [Bumble](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378348) to come outside, either with the Child at Heart perk or by passing a Speech check
- Lead Bumble outside to a child slaver waiting for them
- Head back to Eulogy Jones

**Quest Rewards:**
- [Boogeyman's Hood](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378349)

locations.title: The Lost Initiate
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Paladin Hoss](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378351) near Falls Church

**Quest Steps:**
- Speak to Paladin Hoss, where the player learns that Initiate Pek has barricaded himself in the back of Falls Church, due to his gun malfunctioning, and asks the player to go and save him.
- Head into Falls Church and push to the back of the first floor and find Pek cowering by himself in a corner.
- If the player has high enough Small Guns or Repair skills, the player may fix Pek's gun.
- Lead Pek out of Falls Church, back to Paladin Hoss.

**Quest Rewards:**
- XP
- If the player asks Hoss for payment:
   - 100 caps

locations.title: Treatment
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Walter](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378353) in [Megaton](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356859)

**Quest Steps:**
- Walter will inform the player that the water pressure at the plant is low, due to three leaks that have sprung around Megaton.
- The player needs to head around Megaton and fix the leaks (30+ Repair skill required). The leaks can be found:
   - On top of the Children of Aton's building
   - Next to the entrance of Megaton on a hill near a staircase
   - Near the path on a hill leading to the common house
- Head back to Walter and tell him it's fixed.

**Quest Rewards:**
- 200 caps
- 100 XP
- Unlocks the repeatable quest [Walter's Scrap Metal](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378352)

locations.title: Overdose
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to [Paulie Cantelli](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=378355) in [Rivet City](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-3/maps/capital-wasteland?locationIds=356907)

**Quest Steps:**
- When speaking to Paulie, give him Psycho, either one or multiple.

**Quest Rewards:**
- Negative Karma

**Quest Notes:** Paulie will eventually go to an abandoned room in the midship deck and overdose.

locations.title: The Door
locations.description: A door near the satellite dishes has a message for you.

locations.title: Warren
locations.description:
_Wolf Den_

At the end of this small cave are two corpses, a mercenary and a wastelander. The mercenary will have a laser pistol (or possibly a laser rifle, level permitting) and ammunition. There are also two stimpaks by the skeleton on the ground just before the bodies.
